# VRHands

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/view/systems/vr_control.cpp`](../../../src/view/systems/vr_control.cpp) · Described in `data/view.json`

The two entities that follow the VR controllers (VRControl).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hands` | `entt::entity[2]` | left, right (VRInput::left / right); entt::null without a headset |

## Notes

Defined in an anonymous namespace of vr_control.cpp: only VRControl sees it. Emplaced in preinit, filled in init.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: VRControl. Created by: VRControl. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |

| [VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | preinit (emplace), init, tick | the two hand entities, made in init, read every tick |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md)**
  - Hands are only made when VRInput is enabled and box.gltf loads; the RigidBody system gives them kinematic Jolt bodies that push dynamic bodies around.
  - Each press of the right trigger spawns a box 20 cm ahead of the controller with 1.5x the hand's velocity (a new entity and Jolt body per press, never destroyed).
